title: Predicting Textbook Oncological Outcomes with Machine Learning: A Retrospective Review of Patients Who Underwent Resection for Malignant Tumours.
snippet: : Textbook oncological outcome (TOO) is a composite measure used to assess the quality of care in surgical oncology. Specifically, in liver surgery, it assesses several domains including intraoperative events, postoperative recovery, liver-specific complications, early mortality, and resection margins.
